title: SoScale: Second-Order Scale Search for FP4 Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2611.16426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet accurate FP4 quantization remains challenging. Practical formats such as MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4 pair a 4-bit floating-point payload with block-wise or hierarchical scale codes, making accuracy highly sensitive to how each local distribution is scaled. Default maximum-absolute-value scaling preserves dynamic range, but can spend scarce FP4 levels on rarely occupied outlier regions and leave dense tensor values poorly resolved. Existing scale-search methods minimize local element-wise reconstruction error, optimizing tensor fidelity rather than layer-output fidelity. We propose SoScale, a second-order weight scale-code search method for hierarchical FP4 quantization. SoScale searches hardware-valid scale codes under a Hessian-aware layer reconstruction objective and couples this search with GPTQ-style error recovery, selecting scales

translated_title: SoScale：面向FP4量化的二阶尺度搜索方法
translated_abstract: 低比特量化可以降低大语言模型（LLM）的内存占用和推理成本，然而精确的FP4量化仍然具有挑战性。实际使用的格式如MXFP4、NVFP4和HiF4将4位浮点载荷与分块或分层的尺度码相结合，这使得模型精度对每个局部分布的缩放方式高度敏感。默认的最大绝对值缩放虽然保留了动态范围，但可能会将稀缺的FP4数值级别浪费在很少被占用的离群值区域，导致密集张量值的分辨率不足。现有的尺度搜索方法最小化局部逐元素重构误差，优化的是张量保真度而非层输出保真度。我们提出SoScale，一种面向分层FP4量化的二阶权重尺度码搜索方法。SoScale在Hessian感知的层重构目标下搜索硬件有效的尺度码，并将该搜索与GPTQ式的误差恢复相结合来选择尺度码。
tldr: 本文提出SoScale方法，通过在Hessian感知的层重构目标下搜索硬件有效的尺度码并结合GPTQ式误差恢复，显著提升了大语言模型分层FP4量化的精度。
en_tdlr: SoScale proposes a second-order scale-code search method for hierarchical FP4 quantization, which searches hardware-valid scale codes under a Hessian-aware layer reconstruction objective coupled with GPTQ-style error recovery to improve quantization accuracy.
